prompts.Map:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: portrait parchment map texture for a 3D fantasy adventure war table in Realms of Varhyr.
Primary request: a beautifully hand-inked map of the Bright Marches, rugged coastal early medieval lands of moors, river fords, hill farms, scattered woodlands and an ominous marsh in the north. The journey goes from southern coastal Seacliffe at the bottom toward northern marshlands at the top.
Style/medium: restrained antique cartography, fine sepia copperplate hatching and softly washed desaturated moss green, slate blue and ochre on warm aged cream parchment. Elegant, serious, tactile, no cartoon style.
Composition/framing: tall portrait 2:3 texture, perfectly flat overhead orthographic scan, paper fills entire image edge to edge. Geographical detail concentrated toward the left and right edges, central 65% mostly light quiet parchment with very subtle rolling terrain, so interactive route paths and miniatures added in code remain legible. Soft coastline along the left margin, hills on the right, sparse handdrawn forests, a narrow winding river. A thin engraved double-rule border inset 4%, a small delicate compass rose near the bottom right. Gentle fold lines and worn paper fibers; no heavy stains.
Constraints: No text, no letters, no numerals, no labels, no routes, no dotted lines, no location markers, no towns or castles, no figurines, no UI. No perspective, no table, no objects casting shadows, no rolled edges. This is only the flat map surface, to put on a modeled tabletop.
prompts.Opening:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: widescreen 16:9 narrative scene and adventure cover for Realms of Varhyr, Bosci's Struggle.
Input images: Image 1 is a reference for the painterly brushwork, coastal architecture, clothing and heraldry of the Bright Marches, not an edit target.
Primary request: Seacliffe at the beginning of a journey to unite the scattered Marches. A rugged coastal stronghold of weathered stone on a sea cliff, harbor and narrow timber town below, a few longships on a silver blue sea. In the foreground at upper left, two distant early medieval travelers and a cloth banner look inland along a moorland path; one is Bosci, rugged chainmail and dark fur cloak, hair in a manbun, seen from behind and small in the landscape. The cream banner has a dark blue fish and wave emblem, matching the reference. Broad sweeping view of coastal marches, wind and pale dawn.
Style: sophisticated painterly fantasy illustration, confident visible oil paint strokes, slate blue ocean, ochre sunlight, windswept green grass, weathered stone. Rugged Anglo-Saxon / Norse frontier; no giant gothic metropolis, no gleaming plate armor, no snow. Atmosphere hopeful but politically tense.
Composition: beautiful cinematic wide landscape, key subjects and horizon in upper two thirds, quiet shadowed moorland in lower third for text overlay supplied by the game. No text, no UI, no lettering, no watermark.
prompts.Fords:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: 16:9 cinematic narrative painting for Realms of Varhyr: Bosci's Struggle.
Primary request: The river wardens at a wide shallow ford in the rugged Bright Marches. Three small early medieval war bands stand on opposite stony banks with their own weathered ochre, faded green and blue cloth banners. In the upper middle foreground, a stern warden captain in practical chainmail and wool stands with arms folded, looking toward a small approaching company across the water. This is a tense political meeting, not a battle. Moorland hills, willows, a distant timber watchtower, silver river water and broken cloud lit by low sunlight. Grounded Anglo-Saxon / Norse frontier atmosphere.
Style: fine painterly fantasy card illustration, visible broken oil brushwork, natural muted earth and moss tones, cool slate water with warm gold highlights. Rich composition and material detail without photographic smoothness, without cartoon rendering.
Composition: wide landscape, all characters and banners in the upper two thirds. Lower third quiet dark wet stones and water, reserved for separately rendered story text. No text, no UI, no letters, no logos.
prompts.Storm:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: widescreen 16:9 narrative painting for Realms of Varhyr, Bright Marches adventure.
Primary request: Storm on the moor. A small company of weary early medieval travelers shelters beside a broken dry-stone wall in the wind-struck moorlands. Chainmail, wool and fur cloaks, canvas packs, a tightly wrapped weathered cream and blue fish banner. They share bread beneath a small improvised lean-to. Sidelong rain, dark heather, wet grass, distant treeless hills in mist, a faint warm lantern sheltered from wind.
Style/medium: accomplished painterly fantasy illustration with broad expressive oil brushstrokes, tactile natural materials, slate gray storm cloud, moss green earth, warm amber lantern as a restrained focal point. Rugged Anglo-Saxon / Norse, solemn yet companionable, grounded rather than magical.
Composition: landscape with company upper left and center, moorland panorama across right, lower third quiet shadowed wet stones for game text supplied separately. No text, no UI, no watermark, no plate armor, no giant castles.
